name: where-am-i
description: A live recap above the prompt as one card: the goal as its title; now, waiting on you and next with their status; and suggested next prompts in the same box (on by default, off in /config). /where for a longer one.

nextSteps.title: Suggested next steps
nextSteps.description: After each turn, 2 or 3 likely next prompts inside the card (one small model call per turn). Off keeps the plain Next row.

leader.title: Leader key
leader.description: Typed first in an empty prompt, then the number, so a stray digit never picks a suggestion.
